title: Phase 1: Builder smoke and recovery proof
description: Minimal smoke initiative to prove the full Builder lifecycle: validate manifest, apply to queue, run with free worker, verify evidence, and optionally exercise crash recovery. One packet, deterministic acceptance, no side effects beyond data/smoke/.

packets.title: Write smoke marker file
packets.objective: Create data/smoke/hello.txt containing the exact string 'KittyBuilder smoke test passed' followed by a newline. Use echo or a minimal write. Do not create any other files. Do not modify any existing files outside data/smoke/.
acceptance_criteria: data/smoke/hello.txt contains the exact string 'KittyBuilder smoke test passed' (trailing newline is fine)
No other files were created or modified
validation_commands: test -f data/smoke/hello.txt || { echo 'FAIL: hello.txt missing'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'KittyBuilder smoke test passed' data/smoke/hello.txt || { echo 'FAIL: wrong content'; exit 1; }
